relationships.evidence_quote: EA treatment significantly increased the protein level of CB2 receptors in the colonic tissues (p < 0.05, Figures 3A,B).

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA significantly decreased the expression levels of IL-1β and iNOS compared with the TNBS group

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA, but not sham EA, reduced mechanical allodynia measured on days 4–7 and visceral hyperalgesia measured on the seventh day.

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: The CB2 receptor antagonist AM630 or CB2 receptor knockout blocked the inhibitory effects of EA on macrophages activation in the colon tissues.

key_findings: Electroacupuncture at BL25 reduced visceral hypersensitivity, macrophage activation and IL-1β/iNOS in TNBS colitis mice.
Effects were abolished by AM630 and in CB2 knockout mice, indicating CB2 dependence.
